content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler fruit, with yogurt is a ready‑to‑eat baby food consisting of pureed selected fruits blended with natural yogurt. It is formulated for children from 6 months onward, providing essential vitamins, minerals, and probiotic cultures from the yogurt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula contains only fruit puree with no added sugar.
Yogurt is enriched with live cultures Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium that support gut health.
The product undergoes gentle heat treatment that retains most of vitamins C and A.
Ideal for babies transitioning to solid foods.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Yogurt provides vitamin B2 and B12, which are important for nervous system development in infants.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Probiotic cultures help balance intestinal flora and improve nutrient absorption.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Calcium from yogurt contributes to strong bones and teeth during rapid growth.

items.title: Vitamins A and C
items.content: Fruit puree supplies vitamin A for vision and vitamin C to boost immunity.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Smooth texture and lack of large pieces make it safe for babies just learning to chew.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Children with known cow‑milk allergy may react to the product.

items.title: Lactose content
items.content: For infants with lactose intolerance, a lactose‑free version should be chosen.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 48 hours.

items.title: Not suitable for infants under 6 months
items.content: Younger babies may have an immature digestive system, so the product is not recommended.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve straight from the pouch, gently warm in the microwave (no more than 30 seconds), or mix into oatmeal, cottage cheese, or vegetable puree.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened pouch in a cool, dry place at 2 °C‑25 °C. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 2 days.
